event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — AI unwind, defensives bid, semis gutted.
Oct existing-home sales printed -7.3% vs -0.5% fc and the Oct NAHB fell to 29 vs 32, reinforcing a growth scare while initial claims came in tight at 19.4 vs 20; the tape resolved that into a semis-led de-risking with money rotating into staples and utilities. QQQ -2.86% and SOXX -6.79% versus XLP +3.31% is a high-to-low rotation, not a broad liquidation.

INDICES — VIX 19.0, up from a 16.3 20-day MA; VIXY +6.31%.
RSP +0.73%, IWM +0.07%, DIA +0.04%, SPY -1.18%, QQQ -2.86%, SOXX -6.79% (IJR +0.63%, IJH -0.80%).
Small > large by 1.81pp.
Most notable cross-asset move: TLT +1.87% as the 10-year yield broke below 5%; gold -2.63% and silver -5.59% broke down despite the equity risk-off.
SPY and QQQ both sit below their 20-day trend (20d -0.42% and -4.94%); flag the 200-DMA — a close below is a CTA sell trigger.

VOLUME & BREADTH — GLD 2.3x, SOXX 1.9x and QQQ 1.9x are the elevated-volume names; DIA 0.8x and IWM 1.0x are being ignored.
QQQ vol 1.9x with price -2.86% is distribution; SPY at 1.9x down 1.18% is distribution too.
Breadth diverges from the tape: 66% advancers, 60% above the 50-DMA, 56% above the 200-DMA, up/down volume 1.01, 90 new 60-day highs vs 35 lows — participation is broadening under the index, which is a mega-cap/AI de-rating, not a broad selloff.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLP Staples +3.31%, XLU Utilities +2.07%, XLV Healthcare +1.32%, XLF Financials +1.09%, XLRE Real Estate +1.09%, XLB Materials +0.72%, XLY Discretionary -0.45%, XLE Energy -0.87%, XLI Industrials -0.94%, XLC Comms -1.42%, XLK Technology -3.29%.
Top industries XHB +3.77% and XRT +2.92%; bottom SOXX -6.79% and WGMI -8.09%.
Flows: XLV +$1,033mm (100th pct) and XLE +$561mm (86th) lead inflows; XLY -$613mm (4th pct) and XLP -$337mm (17th) bleed — staples' price strength is not flow-confirmed, so it's defensive short-covering rather than conviction.
Rotation state: AI hardware fading / high-to-low rotation.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 2.45 and QQQ 1.38 = heavy protection demand; skew +7.6%/+7.1% = put premium = fear.
VIX 19.0 vs 16.3 MA20 and VVIX 107.9 vs 91.8 MA20 = elevated fear; no MOVE/OZX print (0.0).
Dispersion is extreme: VIXEQ 42.4 vs VIX 19.0 — a stock-pickers'/rotation tape, not correlated macro.

CROSS-ASSET — Semis -6.79% dragged Nasdaq vol (VXN 28.7 vs 22.8 MA20) while TLT +1.87% caught the flight-to-quality bid and gold's -2.63% break is the unusual divergence — real yields, not fear, are driving the safe-haven bid.
Next FOMC Oct 28, 2026: CME FedWatch shows hold 0.0%, cut 0.0%, hike 100.0%. Polymarket prices 72% for another 2026 hike and 71% for a December 25bp hike.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 56.5 (Neutral) against VIX 19.0.
Movers: LRCX -11.76% (Tickeron, wafer-fab demand), SPOT +11.10% (subscriber growth/AI optimism), GEV -10.64%.
Vol spikes: SPOT 3.2x on price up = accumulation; LRCX 2.6x on price down = distribution.
Watch: GLD -2.63% at 2.3x volume + PCR 0.70 — flow +in $800mm (79th) but price breaking, a cross-asset conflict; SLV -5.59% (20d -14.37%) momentum break; IWM +0.07% vs RSP +0.73% — small-cap leadership is broadening, watch if it holds.
